text:
julia_csm: @kyle_infra Heads-up: Lumenate hitting pilot traffic from Johannesburg (ZA). They need a temporary regional egress allowlist + rate bump to support a partner demo. Renewal flagged as medium-high (renewal 2026-05-10).

kyle_infra: Got it. Can you paste exact CIDRs and target qps? Also any special headers we should permit?

alex_lumenate: Hi! Thanks — sending details. Primary CIDR 196.25.12.0/24. We'll peak at ~600 rps for 48h. We also need header "X-Client-Id" allowed for our proxy auth.

sam_oncall: We can provision a soft bump to 600 rps scoped to af-south-1 (ZA) on the proxy pool. Recommend KV-cache warmup before start to avoid 5xx from cold caches. What start time do you want?

julia_csm: Planning a canary start 2026-04-01T09:00Z for 48h. We'll coordinate an enablement session with the customer Monday to walk through failover and metrics. Renewal owner will track this as a positive engagement.

kyle_infra: Applying config — please confirm CIDR and header exactly. Snippet I'm about to apply: ```yaml
customer: lumenate
region: af-south-1
allowlist_cidrs:
  - 196.25.12.0/24
rate_limit_rps: 600
duration: 48h
allowed_headers:
  - X-Client-Id
prewarm_kv: true
canary_start: 2026-04-01T09:00Z
```

alex_lumenate: Confirmed: 196.25.12.0/24 and header exactly "X-Client-Id". Start time +1 day is perfect. Appreciate the quick turn.

deploybot: deploybot: change queued -> applying to proxy-lumenate-af-south-1. allowlist updated, rate_limit set to 600 rps, kv-cache warmup scheduled. Link: https://deploys.redwood.internal/changes/cc-1777 :rocket:

sam_oncall: I'll monitor the dashboard for 5xx > 1% and token latency regressions. If we see >2% error or latency >500ms P95, we'll rollback and alert.

julia_csm: :thumbsup: Adding notes to the onboarding playbook and renewal touchpoints. I'll capture customer feedback after the demo and share any follow-ups here."
